Wechseln or Umsteigen? German B1 Travel Word Choice

Distinguish changing an item or service from changing vehicles during a journey. Practise wechseln and the separable verb umsteigen.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Wechseln can describe replacing or changing something: den Anbieter wechseln, die Schuhe wechseln. Umsteigen commonly means getting off one vehicle and continuing in another: in Mannheim umsteigen. Der Zugwechsel and den Zug wechseln can also describe that travel change; umsteigen is a typical verb for the passenger’s action.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not invent a total ban on wechseln in transport contexts. Den Zug wechseln is possible; the exercise targets the supplied verb pattern and meaning.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Wir wechseln im Büro den Internetanbieter.We change the internet provider at the office.
Worked example 2Auf dem Weg nach Basel steigen wir in Mannheim um.On the way to Basel we change trains in Mannheim.
Worked example 3Vor der Wanderung wechselt sie ihre Schuhe.Before the hike she changes her shoes.
Worked example 4Am Hauptbahnhof kannst du in die U-Bahn umsteigen.At the central station you can change to the underground.

Practice: choose the right word

Use wechseln for changing the named item/provider and umsteigen for the specified vehicle change. Fill only the finite stem when um is supplied. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich ___ nach der Arbeit meine nassen Socken. (change an item)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: wechsle

Ich wechsle is a common present form; ich wechsele is also standard.

Question 2. In Fulda ___ wir in einen anderen Zug um. (umsteigen)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: steigen

Umsteigen separates into steigen ... um.

Question 3. Möchtest du den Stromanbieter ___? (change provider)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: wechseln

After möchtest, the infinitive wechseln expresses changing a provider.

Question 4. Wo müssen wir in die Straßenbahn ___? (change vehicle)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: umsteigen

The modal müssen takes the bare infinitive umsteigen.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
